sources.evidence: Official Bancor documentation for the V3 protocol and its user-facing network role; the exact Ethereum user proxy is cross-checked against the project-owned pinned mainnet deployment artifact below.

Owned Bancor contracts-v3 commit 97d7905b8548470e79d40ce02e09b006f555aa11 interface declares the selected six user methods, exact typed parameters, mutability, and unnamed uint256 outputs. Excludes tradeBy*Arb, depositFor, flashloan, and administrative methods.

Owned Bancor implementation at the same pinned commit confirms the declared deposit and withdrawal flow: deposit accepts a Token pool/base-token argument and amount and returns pool-token amount; initWithdrawal accepts IPoolToken receipt amount and returns request ID; cancellation/completion are ID-based and completion requires eligible request state.

Owned mainnet artifact at the same commit maps the BancorNetwork user proxy role to Ethereum chain 1 address 0xeEF417e1D5CC832e619ae18D2F140De2999dD4fB and contains the exact full ABI selected below. Snapshot role and interface evidence do not prove current runtime implementation or funded execution.
